# Lapiz Blue

> Lapiz Blue General Trading LLC is a building materials supplier in the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah), authorised reseller of Mapei, and distributor of Laticrete, Weber, Kerakoll, Vetonit, Pidilite Puma, AkzoNobel (Dulux), Profilpas, Montolit and Hilti. Named Outstanding Construction Material Wholesaler in the 2026 Dubai Local Awards.

- [About](https://www.lapizblue.com/about): leadership, group companies, certificates, awards
- [Construction chemicals distributor in Dubai](https://www.lapizblue.com/construction-chemicals-dubai): what Lapiz Blue supplies, brands it is authorized for, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah branches, FAQ
- [Waterproofing supplier in Dubai](https://www.lapizblue.com/waterproofing-supplier-dubai): Mapei, Laticrete, Weber and Kerakoll waterproofing membranes by application area, brands, branches, FAQ
- [Concrete repair supplier in Dubai](https://www.lapizblue.com/concrete-repair-supplier-dubai): Mapei and Weber repair mortars, grouts, admixtures and anchoring by defect type, brands, branches, FAQ
- [Epoxy flooring supplier in Dubai](https://www.lapizblue.com/epoxy-flooring-supplier-dubai): Mapei and Laticrete epoxy, polyurethane and quartz flooring systems, AkzoNobel CRAFCO Traffic Deck coatings, by space, brands, branches, FAQ
- [Tile adhesive supplier in Dubai](https://www.lapizblue.com/tile-adhesive-supplier-dubai): Mapei, Laticrete, Weber and Kerakoll tile adhesives and grouts by class and job, brands, branches, FAQ
